<div class="wc-intro">
<p>This page lists the changes to BetaNYC&#x27;s template for Research and Data Assistance Request (RADAR) reports, the starting point the Civic Innovation Lab copies for each new report: new layout features, table options, and setup steps. Newest first. A report made from the template keeps its own list of changes, so if you copy the template, replace this file with your report&#x27;s history.</p>
<ul><li><strong>History begins:</strong> 2026-06-29. The template was first published on this date. Earlier work on it is not listed, and corrections made before it may be missing.</li><li><strong>Data refresh:</strong> None. The template holds an example report, not live data.</li></ul>
<p>To report a bug in the template, or to ask for a new feature, <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/issues">open an issue on GitHub</a>.</p>
</div>
<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-11-12-new-page-listing-what-has-changed-in-the-template" data-tags="Site" aria-labelledby="2026-11-12-new-page-listing-what-has-changed-in-the-template-title">
<h2 id="2026-11-12-new-page-listing-what-has-changed-in-the-template-title">New page listing what has changed in the template</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-11-12">November 12, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span></p>
<p>This page is new, and every new report now starts with one. It lists the changes a reader would notice, and gives a place to say plainly if a report ever publishes a number that turns out to be wrong. A link to it will appear in the footer of every page the next time the site is rebuilt.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/commits/main">The change history in this repository</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-11-12-new-page-listing-what-has-changed-in-the-template">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: New page listing what has changed in the template</span></a></p>
</article>
<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-09-15-setup-instructions-an-optional-database-and-a-source-code-link" data-tags="Site" aria-labelledby="2026-09-15-setup-instructions-an-optional-database-and-a-source-code-link-title">
<h2 id="2026-09-15-setup-instructions-an-optional-database-and-a-source-code-link-title">Setup instructions, an optional database, and a source code link</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-09-15">September 15, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span></p>
<p>The template now comes with instructions for setting it up and publishing a report, an optional database for reports that use geographic data, and a footer link to the report&#x27;s source code. The table helper moved into its own file so reports can share it.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/issues/3">Issue 3</a> · <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/commit/da7e344">The change</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-09-15-setup-instructions-an-optional-database-and-a-source-code-link">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: Setup instructions, an optional database, and a source code link</span></a></p>
</article>
<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-09-10-more-control-over-table-layout" data-tags="Site" aria-labelledby="2026-09-10-more-control-over-table-layout-title">
<h2 id="2026-09-10-more-control-over-table-layout-title">More control over table layout</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-09-10">September 10, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span></p>
<p>Tables in the template&#x27;s style can now have set column widths, a background fill, and a fixed height that shows every row.</p>
<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/commit/bd3a9ff">The change</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-09-10-more-control-over-table-layout">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: More control over table layout</span></a></p>
</article>
<article class="wc-entry" id="2026-09-08-updated-table-and-page-style-and-a-browser-tab-icon" data-tags="Site" aria-labelledby="2026-09-08-updated-table-and-page-style-and-a-browser-tab-icon-title">
<h2 id="2026-09-08-updated-table-and-page-style-and-a-browser-tab-icon-title">Updated table and page style, and a browser tab icon</h2>

<p><strong>More detail:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/commit/3c5fa80">Table and style update</a> · <a href="https://github.com/BetaNYC/radar-quarto-template/commit/804ab09">Browser tab icon</a></p>
<p class="wc-permalink"><a href="#2026-09-08-updated-table-and-page-style-and-a-browser-tab-icon">Link to this change<span class="wc-visually-hidden">: Updated table and page style, and a browser tab icon</span></a></p>

<h2 id="2026-06-29-the-template-is-published-with-the-civic-innovation-labs-design-title">The template is published with the Civic Innovation Lab&#x27;s design</h2>
<p class="wc-meta"><time datetime="2026-06-29">June 29, 2026</time></p>
<p class="wc-tags"><span class="wc-visually-hidden">Tags: </span><span class="wc-tag">Site</span></p>
